# Isolation trial sample

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

This public input belongs to the official HanaWorlds Desktop origin. It has no business feature, world write, credential operation, background task, retry, boot flag, simulated Host, or diagnostic log fabrication. It is not an Inspector repair and does not explain the historical Inspector activation failure.

Install its exact committed tar through the normal Plugins → Add plugin → Install → Enable now path. The bundle patch uses the public `insert` operation to add its component; a bare `id` row would only override an existing component and cannot create one. Version 0.1.1 corrects that input and exports package metadata and English/Chinese labels. The real Host entry activates without side effects. The Host's ordinary module graph serves `client.js`, which registers through the public lazy-CJS protocol. On the real client's first factory materialization it throws the visibly labelled sample error. A normal Quit and cold launch must exercise the same ordinary activation path; a unit or fixture result is not runtime isolation evidence.

The expected trial result is a usable Home and Plugins page, a named failure for `hanaworlds-isolation-trial-sample` preserving its first original message, stack and factory phase, and a different healthy plugin's real usable panel. Keep this entry enabled while checking those results. This sample intentionally provides no client exports or panel of its own. It publishes no invariant installer: there is no independent runtime relationship in this input; the product trial observes the Host, Loader, failure presentation and healthy panel separately.

Package identity, exact tar digest, every shipped file and the frozen Desktop source commit are recorded by the consuming card's public REPORT. A missing source stamp stays unknown; no historical or unrelated source is substituted. The source engineering check executes the supplied client artifact through real composition, Loader and module machinery in a fixture; it separately records component discovery and the factory exception, without claiming App cold-start or healthy-panel proof.
